name: mitii-ai-agent
description: Private Mitii monorepo workspace orchestrator. Product packages: @mitii/ui-core, @mitii/ui-theme, @mitii/ui-react, @mitii/ui-protocol, @mitii/v8, @mitii/sdk, @mitii/automation, @mitii/search-kit, @mitii/mcp, @mitii/mcp-web, @mitii/mcp-sqlite, @mitii/mcp-postgres, @mitii/mcp-mongo, @mitii/mcp-sql, @mitii/host, @mitii/cli, @mitii/daemon, @mitii/acp, @mitii/desktop, apps/vscode.

scripts.build:all: pnpm run build && pnpm run rebuild:native
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build && pnpm -r --filter @mitii/settings --filter @mitii/ui-core --filter @mitii/ui-theme --filter @mitii/ui-react --filter @mitii/ui-protocol --filter @mitii/v8 --filter @mitii/sdk --filter @mitii/automation --filter @mitii/search-kit --filter @mitii/mcp --filter @mitii/mcp-web --filter @mitii/mcp-sqlite --filter @mitii/mcp-postgres --filter @mitii/mcp-mongo --filter @mitii/mcp-sql --filter @mitii/host --filter @mitii/cli --filter @mitii/daemon --filter @mitii/acp --filter @mitii/desktop --filter ./apps/vscode run typecheck
scripts.test: node scripts/ensure-node-native.mjs && vitest run && pnpm run test:ui && pnpm run test:webview && pnpm run test:cli && pnpm run test:desktop
scripts.verify: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm run build:all
scripts.preflight: pnpm run release:check-assets && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm run rebuild:native
scripts.package:preflight: pnpm run preflight && pnpm run package
scripts.version:major: pnpm version major --no-git-tag-version --force && pnpm run readme:sync-version && pnpm run sync:versions
scripts.version:minor: pnpm version minor --no-git-tag-version --force && pnpm run readme:sync-version && pnpm run sync:versions
scripts.version:patch: pnpm version patch --no-git-tag-version --force && pnpm run readme:sync-version && pnpm run sync:versions
scripts.postinstall: node -e "console.log('Fresh compile: pnpm build. F5-ready (compile + Electron SQLite): pnpm build:all. ABI only: rebuild:native (editor) or rebuild:node (tests/CLI).')"
scripts.test:ui: pnpm --filter @mitii/ui-core test && pnpm --filter @mitii/ui-theme test && pnpm --filter @mitii/ui-react test && pnpm --filter @mitii/ui-protocol test
